title: Minimum Advertised Pricing: Patterns of Violation in Competitive Retail Markets
eligible_reason: No panel, no treatment timing. The data are one observation per retailer x SKU x market averaged over the sample period (vio_rate, vio_depth) and the regressions are cross-sectional OLS and 2SLS of violation rate/depth on an authorized-retailer dummy interacted with retailer and market characteristics (reg vio_rate NotAuth AuthX* NotAuthX*, cluster(retailer_id); ivregress 2sls ...). No time dimension, no fixed effects, no adoption event.
design_notes: Cross-sectional regressions (Tables 5 and 6) on 'MAP data files/random_5percent.dta' (520 retailer-SKU-market observations, 5% random sample of the annual database). The ft_callaway flag is presumably a false positive (author surname or unrelated citation).

specs.exclusion_reason: cross-sectional OLS; no panel or treatment timing
specs.treatment_var: NotAuth and AuthX*/NotAuthX* interactions (not a treatment)

data_files: MAP data files/random_5percent.dta (5% random sample, 520 obs)
screener_notes: Screened from package only (Readme.txt and Table 2,5,6.do read in full).
